name: video-workflow
title_zh: 本地免费流水线：一句话脚本到多格式成片MP4
tagline_zh: 脚本、大纲、CSV/JSON 都能喂——它自己找素材、配旁白、卡字幕、做动画，最后吐出一整套多格式 MP4。
tagline_en: Feed it a script, outline, or dataset—it sources visuals, narrates, captions, and animates into multi-format.
desc_en: Turn a one-sentence video request, locked script, structured content plan, or CSV/JSON dataset into sourced, synchronized, multi-format MP4s through a free local production path. Use for explainers, listicles, tutorials, comparisons, product promos, and data stories when Codex should direct semantic visuals, generate continuous narration, align verbatim captions and content-led animation, design a
why_zh: 不是拼接模板，而是内容驱动的全流程编排：语义选图、逐字字幕、动画跟着旁白走。
why_en: Not template stitching—content-led orchestration: semantic visuals, verbatim captions, animation synced to narration, and data.
limit_zh: 只认四类内容：解说、清单、教程、对比/促销/数据故事；输入必须是锁定脚本或结构化大纲/数据集。自由对话会反复追问。
limit_en: Only handles explainers, listicles, tutorials, comparisons/promos/data stories; needs a locked script or structured outline/dataset. Free-form chat.
title_en: Local Free Pipeline: One-Liner to Multi-Format MP4
